job: Test existing secondary-loss advance warning during finite-slope mains collapse and derive the raw-voltage warning window.
limits: Same50VA/6800uF loaded-secondary surrogate as VAL-051; transformer and source impedance are not guaranteed or selected.
Both secondary amplitudes ramp together. Individual rail shorts and regulator failures are not represented.
First raw floor crossing means loss of documented3V regulator input-output reserve, not necessarily audio corruption.
A separate output=max(0,min(setpoint,raw-3V)) diagnostic supplies only a memoryless dropout sensitivity; it is not a regulator model and excludes local capacitor dynamics.
REF5 and comparator supply validity are assumed over the comparison interval; full reference and logic power sequencing is not modeled.
Raw warning trials are ideal threshold timings, not selected circuits or guaranteed trip thresholds.
Conditional relay current decay plus5ms contact/logic allocation is reused; actual contact timing remains unqualified.
Engineering failures must be retained; this diagnostic does not qualify purchasing, native CAD, quiet audio or populated fit.
